handbook-guide-text:
RPG Classes
Pick a class, learn skills, build your talents.

Choosing a class
Open the class picker with canrpgclassselect (or the "Change Class" button next to your character screen). Your first pick is always free; changing later may cost a fee or have a cooldown, depending on server settings.

Resources
Each class fuels its skills from its own resource pool shown on your hotbar: Rogues use fast-regenerating Energy, Paladins use slower Mana. Some skills also build or spend combo points (up to 5) - "builder" skills generate them, "finisher" skills consume all of them for a bigger effect.

Skills and talents
Open your Spellbook with canrpgspellbook to see every skill you've unlocked and bind them to hotbar slots. Open your Talents with canrpgtalents to spend the talent point you earn every level (up to level 25) across your class's three talent trees - spending points unlocks new active skills and sharpens your build's role.

Attributes
Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence and Wisdom rise with your level and class, and talents or gear can raise them further. Each point pays out in stats - weapon damage, health, spell power, magic resistance - and how much a point is worth depends on your class. Your character sheet lists what yours are paying for right now.

HUD
Your skill hotbar, resource bar, cast bar and combo points are all shown as an always-on overlay. Open canrpghud to reposition, resize, or reorient any of them - drag the highlighted boxes on screen while the settings panel is open.

Paladin - a holy warrior. Holy (healing), Protection (tank), Retribution (melee damage). Resource: Mana + Devotion.

Rogue - a stealthy blade-fighter. Stealth (mobility/openers), Combat (sustained damage), Utility (survival). Resource: Energy + combo points.
class-rogue-desc: A fast-energy melee striker who builds combo points and spends them on brutal finishers. Opens from stealth, controls with stuns and blinds, and coats blades in poison.
class-paladin-desc: A holy warrior who builds and spends Devotion. Heal allies, tank with active mitigation, or smite in melee - seals and auras are shared across all three trees.
class-hunter-desc: A bow hunter who fights alongside a tamed beast. Empowers its next bow shot, lays traps and slows foes, and keeps its distance while the pet pins the enemy in melee.
class-warrior-desc: A rage-fuelled fighter who swaps combat stances. Huge two-handed strikes and execute phases, or an active-mitigation shield tank that soaks hits for the group.
class-priest-desc: A mana caster who mends allies with Discipline shields and Holy heals, or turns to Shadow for damage-over-time. Powerful support, but frail up close.
class-mage-desc: A fragile cloth caster of Fire, Frost and Arcane. Deals huge damage from afar, but never heals - it survives only on shields, Flicker and crowd control.
class-shaman-desc: A mail-wearing hybrid who calls on the elements: nature and fire spells, weapon imbues in melee, or chain heals for the group. Plants totems, wears reactive shields and runs as a wolf.
class-druid-desc: A shapeshifter who fights in animal forms: a ranged nature caster, a combo-point cat, a rage-fuelled bear tank, or a mana healer. Each form is a real model swap with its own abilities and resource.

talentdesc-warrior-payback: Reflect {0}% of melee damage taken back at the attacker per rank.

talentdesc-warrior-bull_rush: Charge stuns the enemy it slams into.

talentdesc-warrior-learn_shield_strike: Unlocks Shield Strike (a hard shield bash).
spelldesc-measured_shot: Empowers your next bow shot with bonus damage. Builds a combo point when it hits. Needs a bow.
spelldesc-finishing_shot: Empowers your next bow shot with heavy damage, harder per combo point spent. Finisher. Needs a bow.
spelldesc-summon_pet: Call a wolf companion to your side. It follows you and attacks your foes.
affinity-heavy_weapon: -{0}% melee damage with a heavy weapon
affinity-light_armor: +{0}% movement speed while not in heavy armor
spelldesc-careful_shot: Empowers your next bow shot with heavy damage - but only a fresh, fully-drawn one. A snap shot won't count. Needs a bow.
spelldesc-split_shot: Your next bow shot looses a fan of extra arrows alongside the main one. Needs a bow.
spelldesc-jarring_shot: Empowers your next bow shot to slow whatever it hits. Your kiting tool. Needs a bow.
spelldesc-venom_sting: Empowers your next bow shot to poison the target over time. Needs a bow.
spelldesc-wounding_shot: Empowers your next bow shot to cut the target's incoming healing for a while. Anti-heal. Needs a bow.
spelldesc-draining_shot: Empowers your next bow shot to drain the target's resource. Anti-caster. Needs a bow.
spelldesc-incendiary_shot: Empowers your next bow shot to set the target ablaze, burning them over time. Needs a bow.
spelldesc-signal_flare: Fire a signal flare that strips invisibility from hidden enemies nearby. No damage.
spelldesc-chill_trap: Set a frost trap at your feet. When an enemy steps on it, it bursts and chills everyone nearby. No damage.
spelldesc-blast_trap: Set an explosive trap at your feet. When an enemy steps on it, it detonates for fire damage to everyone nearby. Doesn't break blocks.
spelldesc-second_breath: Instantly heal a small amount plus a big share of your missing health - a huge save when nearly dead, a weak top-up at high HP.
spelldesc-concealment: Blend into the terrain: creatures notice you from much closer for a while. Not invisibility - no shimmer, and it won't stop a foe that already sees you.
spelldesc-hunter_disengage: Leap backward and chill every enemy around where you stood, so pursuers fall behind.
spelldesc-fresh_quiver: Instantly reset the cooldowns of your traps and survival tools.
talentdesc-hunter-learn_careful_shot: Unlocks Careful Shot (a slow, heavy ranged nuke).
talentdesc-hunter-deadeye: +{0}% damage to targets more than {1} blocks away per rank.
talentdesc-hunter-learn_split_shot: Unlocks Split Shot (a frontal fan of arrows).
talentdesc-hunter-bow_combo: Landing a bow shot builds a combo point.
talentdesc-hunter-learn_wounding_shot: Unlocks Wounding Shot (a shot that cuts the target's healing).
talentdesc-hunter-learn_draining_shot: Unlocks Draining Shot (a shot that drains the target's resource).
talentdesc-hunter-learn_incendiary_shot: Unlocks Incendiary Shot (a shot that sets the target ablaze).
talentdesc-hunter-precise_aim: Bow shots have a {0}% chance per rank to crit for +{1}% damage.
talentdesc-hunter-learn_disengage: Unlocks Disengage (leap back and chill nearby foes).
talentdesc-hunter-learn_blast_trap: Unlocks Blast Trap (a fiery damage area).
talentdesc-hunter-trap_mastery: +{0}% trap damage and control duration per rank.
talentdesc-hunter-learn_signal_flare: Unlocks Signal Flare (reveals hidden enemies in an area).
talentdesc-hunter-napalm: Your Blast Trap also sets enemies caught in the blast on fire.
talentdesc-hunter-learn_fresh_quiver: Unlocks Fresh Quiver (resets your trap and survival cooldowns).
spelldesc-tend_beast: Heal your wolf companion. No effect without a pet out.
spelldesc-beast_fury: Enrage your wolf, boosting its damage for a while. No effect without a pet out.
spelldesc-pet_aggressive: Order your wolf to hunt freely - it auto-attacks nearby foes and assists you.
spelldesc-pet_defensive: Order your wolf to hold - it won't hunt on its own, only engaging what you attack or send it at.
spelldesc-pet_passive: Order your wolf to stand down - it won't attack unless you give an explicit Attack order.
spelldesc-pet_attack: Send your wolf at the foe under your crosshair.
spelldesc-pet_come: Recall your wolf to your side.
spelldesc-pet_stay: Toggle your wolf between holding its ground here and following you.
spelldesc-pet_dismiss: Send your wolf away. Despawns it with no summon cooldown, so you can resummon at will.
talentdesc-hunter-venom: Your pet's bite poisons its target (stronger per rank).
talentdesc-hunter-bloodletting: Your pet heals for {0}% of the damage it deals per rank.
talentdesc-hunter-pack_tactics: +{0}% damage to your pet's current target per rank.
talentdesc-hunter-cowing_roar: Your pet's bite slows its target (stronger per rank).
talentdesc-hunter-beast_call: -{0}% pet revival delay after it dies, per rank.
talentdesc-hunter-wild_chase: Beast Fury lasts {0}% longer and adds {1}% more pet damage.
talentdesc-rogue-quiet_steps: Mobs notice you from {0}% less range per rank.
talentdesc-rogue-learn_venom_coat: Unlocks Venom Coat (coat your weapon in poison).
talentdesc-rogue-learn_blind: Unlocks Blind (incapacitate at range; breaks on damage).
talentdesc-rogue-learn_crippling_oil: Unlocks Crippling Oil (hits slow the target).
talentdesc-rogue-learn_shadow_stride: Unlocks Shadow Stride (blink behind the target).
talentdesc-rogue-learn_slip_away: Unlocks Slip Away (turn invisible and break combat).
talentdesc-rogue-blindside: +{0}% damage when striking from behind, per rank.
talentdesc-rogue-jagged_blades: Melee hits make the target bleed; lasts longer per rank.
talentdesc-rogue-learn_open_wound: Unlocks Open Wound (bleed finisher, scales with combo).
talentdesc-rogue-learn_whirling_knives: Unlocks Whirling Knives (AoE damage around you).
talentdesc-rogue-learn_evasion: Unlocks Evasion (chance to dodge physical attacks).
talentdesc-rogue-learn_disengage: Unlocks Disengage (leap back and vanish briefly).
talentdesc-rogue-learn_disarm: Unlocks Disarm (knock the target's weapon out of hand).
talentdesc-rogue-learn_regroup: Unlocks Regroup (resets your mobility and survival cooldowns).

spelldesc-shadow_stride: Flicker behind the aimed target and briefly turn invisible.
spelldesc-slip_away: Become invisible with a burst of move speed to escape.
spelldesc-charge: Charge to the targeted enemy, gain move speed, and build rage.
spelldesc-second_wind: Instantly heal, plus regeneration over a few seconds.
spelldesc-venom_coat: Coat your weapon with poison for the next few melee hits.
spelldesc-crippling_oil: Coat your weapon so melee hits slow the target.
spelldesc-counterstrike: Reflect a portion of incoming melee damage.
spelldesc-bloodletting: Heal for a share of the melee damage you deal.
spelldesc-disengage: Leap backward and briefly vanish to break off a fight.

spelldesc-fearsome_shout: Demoralize nearby enemies, weakening their attacks.

spelldesc-nerve_strike: Stun the aimed target for a few seconds.
spelldesc-eye_jab: Briefly stun the aimed target to create distance.

spelldesc-sprint: Sharply increase your movement speed for a short time.
spelldesc-whirling_knives: Hurl knives at all enemies around you.
spelldesc-battle_rush: Boost your movement speed and melee damage for a while.
spelldesc-open_wound: Strike the aimed target, causing heavy bleeding over time.
spelldesc-disarm: Knock the target's weapon out of hand (players) or weaken its attacks (mobs).
spelldesc-regroup: Instantly reset the cooldowns of Slip Away, Sprint, Disengage, Second Wind and Shadow Stride.
spelldesc-evasion: For a short time, you have a chance to fully dodge incoming melee and ranged attacks.
spelldesc-stealth: Slip Away from sight to approach unseen. Breaks when you attack; out of combat you can stay hidden indefinitely.
spelldesc-magic_bolt: Fire a bolt that damages the first thing it hits.

spelldesc-avenging_light: Gain a burst of melee strength and movement speed.
spelldesc-radiant_seal: Coat your weapon with holy light so your hits weaken foes.

spelldesc-cleanse: Remove harmful effects from an ally or yourself.
spelldesc-reckoning: Force nearby mobs to attack you.
spelldesc-light_cascade: Instantly heal yourself and all nearby allies with a burst of holy light.
